{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":7,"lineType":2,"content":"臣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":7,"lineType":1,"content":"等謹案：李虚中命書三卷，舊本題鬼谷子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"撰，唐李虚中註。虚中字常容，魏侍中李冲八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"世孫，進士及第。元和中官至殿中侍御史。韓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"愈為作墓誌銘，見於昌黎文集。後世傳星命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"之學者，皆以虚中為祖。愈墓誌中所云最深","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804215636754475"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"五行書，以人之始生年月日所值日辰支干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"相生勝衰死王相斟酌，推人夀夭貴賤利不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"利，輙先處其年時，百不失一二者是也。然愈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"但極稱其説之汪洋奥羙，萬端千緒，而不言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"有所著書。唐書藝文志亦無是書之名。至宋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"志始有李虚中命書格局二卷。鄭樵藝文畧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"則作李虚中命術一卷，命書補遺一卷。晁公","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"武讀書志又作李虚中命書三卷。焦氏經籍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804215636770859"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"志又於命書三卷外，别出命書補遺一卷。名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"目卷數皆參錯不合。世間傳本久絶，無以考","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"正其異同。惟永樂大典所収，其文尚多完具，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"卷帙前後，亦頗有次苐。並載有虚中自序一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"萹，稱司馬李主於壺山之陽遇鬼谷子，出遺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"文九萹，論幽微之理，虚中為掇拾諸家，注釋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"成集云云。詳勘書中義例，首論六十甲子，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"及生人時刻干支，其法頗與韓愈墓誌所言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804215636787243"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"始生年月日者相合。而後半乃多稱四柱，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"説實起於宋，與前文殊相繆戻。且其他職官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"稱謂，多涉宋代之事，其不盡出虚中手，尤為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"明甚。中間文筆有古奥難解者，似屬唐人所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"為；又有鄙淺可嗤者，似出後來附益。真偽雜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"出，莫可究詰。疑唐代本有此書，宋時談星學","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"者以説闌入其間，托名於虚中之注鬼谷，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"自神其術耳。今以其議論精切近理，多得星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804215636803627"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"命正㫖，與後來之幻𣺌恍惚者不同，故依晁氏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"原目，𨤲為三卷，著之於録，以存其法。而於其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"依托之顯然者，則各加案語，隨文紏正，俾讀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"者毋為所惑焉。乾隆四十六年九月恭校上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3","lineNum":5,"lineType":1,"content":"昔司馬季主居壺山之陽，一夕雨餘，風清月朗，有叟踵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"4","lineNum":7,"lineType":1,"content":"門，自謂鬼谷子。季主因與談天地之始，論河洛之書、箕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"子九疇、文王八卦，探賾幽微，造化至曉。出遺文九篇，包","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"括三才，指陳萬物。季主得而明之，毎言人之禍福、時數、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"吉凶，應如神察，為當時所貴。今余得其舊文，稽攷頗經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"證效。惟歴世之久，篇目次序似乎乖異，其五行之要，尚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"或備載。余恐其本術將至湮没，故掇拾諸家註釋成集，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804346095992867"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"非敢補於闕文，且傳之不朽，髙明君子母我誚焉。唐元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"和初載九月十三日，殿中侍御史李常容虚中序。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"案：唐惟天寶、至徳稱載，此序後元和而亦稱載，是即","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"作偽之一證。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":6,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子天官蔵，是子旺母衰之金，溺於水下而韜光，湏假","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":8,"lineType":1,"content":"火革，有旺盛之氣，方可以揚名顯用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":8,"lineType":2,"content":"命入貴格，明暗取官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑祿官承，乃庫墓守財之金，不嫌鬼旺之方，喜見祿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"財之地。水土砥礪，忽然有氣，亦可以為器成材。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":12,"lineType":2,"content":"平和貴格，不湏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":14,"lineType":2,"content":"禄到。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"11","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅祿地元，是子母相承之火，先煙後熖，抽其明而三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892070924331"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"進，喜木為助，嫌水陵遲。五行相養，雖在死方，亦可光耿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":22,"lineType":2,"content":"命入貴格，不用干祿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"15","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯貴祿奇，乃本旺祿休之火。惟欲隂旺，惡處盛陽。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"火木相資，連於艮震之方，必能變鼎味而成享禮也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":26,"lineType":2,"content":"欲逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":28,"lineType":2,"content":"官鬼，始得貴奇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"19","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰神頭祿，乃華實𠔥榮之木，愛乎水土，忌見火金。有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"所養於金，乃英實之命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":32,"lineType":2,"content":"相乘可貴，不畏鬼臨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"22","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"巳巳地奇備，乃氣勝體剛之木，生逢對旺，干鬼相加，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892070940715"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"木來比助，金伐以成，為棟梁之材，皆得終美。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":38,"lineType":2,"content":"貴無官鬼，湏見角音。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午天祿承，是含輝始育之土。氣數未備，惟喜旺方。得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"數已完，尚嫌水重。若獨祿㑹，命旺身絶，豈是貴地？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":42,"lineType":2,"content":"祿鬼自處，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":44,"lineType":2,"content":"不假官鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"30","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未，祿自蔵，乃自本立形之土。有火相助，得木相乘，水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"輕木重，亦可以小康。若敗而乘祿多，方為厚載之福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":48,"lineType":2,"content":"喜見干連，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":50,"lineType":2,"content":"不畏木重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"34","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申地天祿，乃自任權制之金。剛而有斷。愛土木而嫌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892070957099"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"火重，雖居財旺身衰，亦主清華之貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":56,"lineType":2,"content":"真假財官，貴之為貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"38","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉，貴符印，乃剛鋭利用之金。不嫌絶敗，惟畏鬼多。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"平易而不相刑，當有自然之材器。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":60,"lineType":2,"content":"庚辛無鬼，不假官貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"41","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌，祿臨官，乃墓成息用之火。不求壯旺。欲物平資福，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"祿可以髙厚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":64,"lineType":2,"content":"入格可貴，干不必官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"44","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥地祿承，為氣散㳺魂之火，生於木火榮方，上下不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"逢相制，僅而成達，多助尤崇，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":68,"lineType":2,"content":"真官相制，得貴亦崇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"47","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子，天祿承，乃深沉停㑹之水。若㑹源得生，用制於東","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892070973483"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"南，為出常之器，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":74,"lineType":2,"content":"自有真官，佳期祿會。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"51","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑祿自守，乃漸下欲流之水。得水土相承，經於敗地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"源脈不斷，可升而濟物，功徳昭著也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":78,"lineType":2,"content":"丑有癸蔵，不明見官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"54","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅地官承，乃生體安和之土。若資之以火土俱盛，金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"旺之榮，雖多反制，尚可髙崇，為不常之用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":82,"lineType":2,"content":"得官不旺，貴出自然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":84,"lineType":1,"content":"巳卯地官承，為鬼旺體堅之土。生於金重木多而見財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":86,"lineType":1,"content":"重，乃富貴長逺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":86,"lineType":2,"content":"得官不旺，貴出自然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"60","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰祿暗㑹，乃顯光之金，而未成材。金剛土重，得期相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892070989867"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹，無炎火之官，乃大臣之制。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":92,"lineType":2,"content":"不假祿合，祿干尅期。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"64","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳地官承，為資始之金，身堅而體柔，欲平火之制。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":96,"lineType":1,"content":"金助土成，則為光大之器。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":96,"lineType":2,"content":"丙官在下，務貴於祿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"67","lineNum":98,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午天官合，乃化薪之木，畏在火强，得水資之，或處生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"旺而逢土，亦可富貴。若獨見金制，在死敗之鄉，非長久","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"之命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":102,"lineType":2,"content":"丁壬徳合，寄任旺官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"71","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"癸未祿自備，為伐根之木。氣敗而體柔，不嫌金制，喜水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"之榮，及㑹元而借生主，乃重器成徳之材。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":106,"lineType":2,"content":"癸在巳中，喜逢甲乙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892071006251"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申地，祿生，乃源泉之水。務有資助，流長而無鬼，則為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"運廣之淵，可享髙厚之福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":112,"lineType":2,"content":"祿始生，要干生旺而無官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"78","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"乙酉貴，還命，乃母旺進趨之水。若資以金，濟用以火，自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"乾東而震北，亦超卓輔弼之用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":116,"lineType":2,"content":"干之無官，會合而貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"81","lineNum":118,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戌祿，徳合，乃祿資支附，堅固火鍾之土。若資之以木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"光耀不羣，蓋本重不湏旺也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":120,"lineType":2,"content":"自有卒符，不畏偏貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"84","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"丁亥地，貴符，乃福壯臨官之土。若潤之以水，麗澤以金，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"處魁罡坤艮之方，可以顯功遂名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":124,"lineType":2,"content":"貴守官蔵真鬼徳旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892071022635"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":128,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子天，祿合，乃神龍之火。利於震巽，不畏水刑。支干得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"官，皆可顯用。水木盛則尤佳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":130,"lineType":2,"content":"自有癸財，不必㑹禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"巳丑神頭祿，乃餘光不凡之火。惟期體重，不假奇財。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"content":"祿有資而命有成，方入康榮之貴局。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":134,"lineType":2,"content":"貴財相會，無祿亦榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"94","lineNum":136,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅地，奇備。不避刑衝，寧辭衰敗。乃五行堅實之木。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"得和柔之氣，徳貴相符，必作顯揚大用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":138,"lineType":2,"content":"祿位生旺，得官鬼成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯貴衝，命自旺。經制之木，不畏霜雪，氣節凌雲。可制","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":142,"lineType":1,"content":"之以金，損之以火，而逢旺相，即成巨室之材。若平易而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892071039019"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"無金火生於曲直之㑹，亦為貴重矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":146,"lineType":2,"content":"祿命相擊，不畏官耗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"102","lineNum":148,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰祿，清潔，乃㑹貴守成之水。五行不雜，在兌坎之間，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":150,"lineType":1,"content":"無物來制。文明清異之資，可享髙厚之福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":150,"lineType":2,"content":"喜於寅亥，見戌亦清。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳地，帶合，乃流逺澄清之水。若溢之以水，在火木榮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":154,"lineType":1,"content":"方，音中無土，則有濟物恵施之徳也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":154,"lineType":2,"content":"真氣得用，官氣尤清。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"108","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午天，符祿，乃沙汰之金。志大而有節操。或零火盖之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"而嚴，或旺金集之而剛。不遇丁壬，始可陶鎔之寶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":158,"lineType":2,"content":"祿神敗而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":160,"lineType":2,"content":"食子，欲妻剛而子旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892071055403"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":164,"lineType":1,"content":"乙未祿，印綬，乃强悍剛礦之金。欲金相用，在火盛處。父","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"子相乘，皆為珍寶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":166,"lineType":2,"content":"徳神當位，喜見印官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"116","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申地，官承，乃無資之火。金木壯旺而有制，得干生即","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"為厚實。若祿盛而無依，即灰飛而不熖矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":170,"lineType":2,"content":"官在生方，不湏癸壬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"丁酉貴自承，乃平易無為之火。得木旺則火炎，見木多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":174,"lineType":1,"content":"則成用，得火助則不清，在火位則常存。人生得此，無不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"貴豪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":176,"lineType":2,"content":"丁連丙貴，見合不清。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"123","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"戊戌神頭祿，乃不材之木。喜逢水旺，乃可資榮。豈厭生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892071071787"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"成。伐宜金敗，真運自然。不嫌祿鬼，方可髙崇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":182,"lineType":2,"content":"明合暗官，成於旺方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":184,"lineType":1,"content":"已亥地官承，乃糞水育苗之木。水多土而臨旺，皆有成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"就。然逢敗絶為殃，亦主富貴榮盛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":186,"lineType":2,"content":"干支財祿，畏彼官鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"130","lineNum":188,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子天雲日承，乃氣過浮虛之土。得重土相資，水木不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":190,"lineType":1,"content":"剛，即享福夀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":190,"lineType":2,"content":"官鬼不刑，衰絶自保。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"133","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"辛丑祿承庫，乃氣衰就本之土。欲承之以火，制之以木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":194,"lineType":1,"content":"或重遇木，土有刑衝，湏假祿元生旺，造化應斯，功名可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"立。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":196,"lineType":2,"content":"官鬼不加，祿剛則貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892071088171"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅地㑹義，乃蔵用體柔之金，喜土資之以旺。財官不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"可太剛。若能應此，富貴始得久逺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":202,"lineType":2,"content":"艮土包命，祿湏貴旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"141","lineNum":204,"lineType":1,"content":"癸卯貴㑹源，乃財旺體弱之金。財命相乘，喜身在生旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"之方，或得真官真氣，無不配合貴源，莫不易而厚祿也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":208,"lineType":2,"content":"貴源多會，不在多逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"144","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰祿馬承，乃始壯之火。欲多生我，或㑹本源，却無炎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"光之極，自然超卓。水輕而無土，亦可騰達矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":212,"lineType":2,"content":"甲丙生寅，明我生氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"乙巳地官承，乃進功之火，欲輔助之不息，不必旺極。得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892071104555"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":218,"lineType":1,"content":"木火相乘，雖死敗而可貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":218,"lineType":2,"content":"或同音煞，丙亦生貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"151","lineNum":220,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午神頭祿，乃至隂之水，發於陽明，蒸氣氤氲，何所不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":222,"lineType":1,"content":"及。處金木旺而衝刑，祿得炎而財盛，始可貴矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":222,"lineType":2,"content":"身同官鬼，不避","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":224,"lineType":2,"content":"掩衝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"155","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"丁未祿文承，乃祿旺育生之水，宜於水火之中，得五行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"死敗之氣，禄干自旺。財貴會於乾方，乃富貴顯揚之用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"惟嫌土在旺鄉，即非長久。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":230,"lineType":2,"content":"喜遇丙丁，畏官當用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"159","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"戊申地符㑹，乃柔順發生之土，喜臨四季，得木為榮。獨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892071120939"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"居水火榮方，未得尊髙之著。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":236,"lineType":2,"content":"真官符用，不畏鬼臨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"已酉貴承，乃子旺母衰之土，喜火土之榮，慶從革之地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"或水輕木柔，亦是滋生之徳。儻能應此，軒冕非難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":240,"lineType":2,"content":"不必正應，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":242,"lineType":2,"content":"要臨辛丙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"167","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌祿符源，乃鈍弱成用之金，火輕金重，魁罡相乘，可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"以休逸，福祿自然。忌木火之極，則命迍蹇，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":246,"lineType":2,"content":"旺逢妻鬼，遇鬼反榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥地祿印，乃木旺祿休之金，得平火之革，然後制于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"尅伐，或衝擊於金水之中，得以平安守職，富貴優游，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":250,"lineType":2,"content":"喜於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892071137323"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":254,"lineType":2,"content":"金助，不畏丁鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"175","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子神頭祿，乃體柔用剛之木，居旺相而得金，遇貴地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":258,"lineType":1,"content":"而無火，則可以揚名當世。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":258,"lineType":2,"content":"祿旺湏官，音盛畏鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"178","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑祿得源，乃剛柔相濟之木水土承於旺方，則生育","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"利物。金制於生成，皆可以立功立事。惟恐生旺逢火，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":262,"lineType":2,"content":"祿居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":264,"lineType":2,"content":"北地，畏鬼掩衝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"182","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅神頭祿，乃淵深處靜之水。若資之木旺土衰，則為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"奇特貴異。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":268,"lineType":2,"content":"庚辛不畏，清在丁壬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892071153707"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯神頭祿，乃死中受氣之水，雖敗無妨。或㑹源於音","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"地，未有不達之者。此一水皆喜土而清。若水多而無土，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"則為伏寒之氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":276,"lineType":2,"content":"癸馬為官，勝於戊巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"190","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辰祿自裕，乃發施養生之土，喜於火助，不畏掩衝。夫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"如是者，自然榮貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":280,"lineType":2,"content":"水在庫中，無官自裕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"193","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"丁已神頭祿，是絶中受氣之土，喜逢土助，不畏死敗。惟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"能朝命建元，可以文章妙選。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":284,"lineType":2,"content":"上下火乗，鬼無害也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"196","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午天祿備，乃神發離明之火，旺中受絶。喜木助於衰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892071170091"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":290,"lineType":1,"content":"方，忌火乘於已旺。生之應此，必作魁英。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":290,"lineType":2,"content":"真假居壯，水盛不傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"已未神頭祿，乃成功之火，得季夏之炎陽，守小吉之貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"地。生自東北之南，有所資附，則能享福厚矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":294,"lineType":2,"content":"甲已扶持，不湏更旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申神頭祿，乃未堅柔末之木，春相夏旺。金重而得火，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"土重而得水，則為出常之器。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":298,"lineType":2,"content":"不畏陽官，要官鬼旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"206","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉神頭祿，乃包秀結英之木。喜於生旺，忌見金多得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"土水相乘，為物之貴。二者各旺而不得水，亦為奇特之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"材。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":304,"lineType":2,"content":"不嫌官鬼，厭甲為財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892071186475"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌祿官順，乃杳𡨋之水。喜於死敗。要土之擊發，則能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"博施之功及物也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":310,"lineType":2,"content":"正氣自守，持祿亦榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"214","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥神頭祿，乃始進成終之水。喜逢貴地，忌在禄鄉。三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"元相反，福慶自然。蓋其為用也大而廣，故不可以守常","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"為尚。湏升而為雨霧，散而為江河，乃為大用也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"217","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"此六十位五行，支干相乘，要分輕重。若金溺水下，火出","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":320,"lineType":1,"content":"水上，木不得金之所制，木無成也。如甲子乙亥是也。金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":322,"lineType":1,"content":"溺水下，火出水上，金不得火之所制，金無成也。如辛亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892071202859"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"之金是也。夫如是而推伏現之情，則造化之機自理。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":326,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼谷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":328,"lineType":2,"content":"子以此十二音五行分輕重之用，以推通變之妙者，尚恐人執守方隅，故言稱顯𨼆，可測造化之説也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":330,"lineType":1,"content":"本家貴人命者，如甲人有戊、有庚、有丑、有未是也，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲人得丁丑辛未，又其次也。盖甲年丑上遁得丁，未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":334,"lineType":1,"content":"上遁得辛也。更有一種貴人，亦為福甚重，得者必貴。甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"戊庚得乙丑、癸未，乙得庚子、戊申，已得丙子、甲申，丙丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"得丁酉、乙亥，壬癸得乙卯、癸已，六辛得丙寅、戊午是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":340,"lineType":1,"content":"甲陽木，戊陽土，庚陽金，皆喜土位。而未者，土之正位，丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892071219243"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"者，土之安靜之地，故以牛羊為貴。然細分之，則甲尤喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"未，庚尤喜丑，各歸其庫也。戊子、戊寅、戊午喜丑。丑者，火人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"胎養之鄉。戊辰、戊申、戊戌喜未，未者，木人之庫，土人生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"旺之地也。乙者，隂木；巳者，隂土也。隂土喜生旺，隂木喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"陽水，所以鼠猴為貴。然乙尤喜申，申者，木之絶鄉也。已尤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"喜子，子者，坤之正位也。丙丁屬火，火墓在戌。壬癸屬水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"墓在辰。辰戌為魁罡之地，貴人所不臨，故尋寄火貴於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"酉亥，寄水貴於卯巳，皆歸静復之鄉。六辛隂金，喜陽火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892071235627"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺之地，故以馬虎為貴。雖然宜以納音互换推尋，湏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"皆和則其貴為福。若丙寅火得酉則火至此，焉足為貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":366,"lineType":1,"content":"哉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":366,"lineType":2,"content":"廣錄：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"244","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"天乙貴人者，三命中最吉之神也。若人遇之，主榮名早","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":370,"lineType":1,"content":"達，官祿易進。若更三命皆乘旺氣，終登將相公卿之位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"大小運行年至此，亦主遷官進財。一切加臨至此，皆為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"吉兆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":374,"lineType":2,"content":"三命指掌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":6,"lineType":1,"content":"通理物化　清氣陽為天，杳杳而上衝乎陽。濁氣隂為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":8,"lineType":1,"content":"地，𡨕𡨋而下從其物。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":8,"lineType":2,"content":"太虚之先，升寂何有？至精感微而真一生焉。真一運靈，而元氣自化。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":10,"lineType":2,"content":"自化元氣者，乃無中之有，有中之無，廣不可量，微不可察，氤氲漸著，混漠無倪，萬象之端，朕兆於此。於是有清","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":12,"lineType":2,"content":"通澄朗之氣化而為天，濁滯煩昧之氣積而為地。故清者自濁而澄，髙者自下而上。天髙而浮，地厚而沈。浮者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":14,"lineType":2,"content":"有彰動之象，故為陽；沈者有寂没之理，故為隂。清者上騰，髙而純陽，故充滿；濁者下沈，密而純隂，故𡨕寂。而萬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":16,"lineType":2,"content":"物從化之。故衝於上者為陽，而生萬物，沈於下者為隂，而成萬物。然而實始於一者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"清濁交分，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804535947919394"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"人物混成，造化始於無相，因而三生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":20,"lineType":2,"content":"太樸之散，乾坤之形，分體一，定乎尊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":22,"lineType":2,"content":"卑。有隂陽之相摩，有剛柔之相推，變動以行其道，經緯以成其事。凡垂象於天者，莫非文也。有髙下之相傾，廣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":24,"lineType":2,"content":"輪之相推，動靜之所生，形勢之所持，凡其質於地者，莫非禮也。故萬物生於其間者，亦且出機入機，出𡨕入㝠，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":26,"lineType":2,"content":"方生方死，方死方生。域於輪轉之地，而機之動不能自已。故草木黄落而菊始華，倉庚鳴而鷹以化。一根荄之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":28,"lineType":2,"content":"細，不知誰與之扶持；一昆蟲之微，不知誰與之生死。戢戢而動植，非物與之雕刻也；芸芸而歸根，非物與之揫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":30,"lineType":2,"content":"歛也。自消自息，自智自力，自形自色，曽不知有造化之者，是人物混然而立也。則其光為日月，其文為星辰，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":32,"lineType":2,"content":"澤為雨露，其威為雷霆。辰集于房，月湛而明，日遄而化，此天之道也。其髙為山嶽，其大為江湖，其文為草木，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":34,"lineType":2,"content":"富為百榖，載萬物而不懾，生萬物而無窮，此地之徳也。髙而為君父，貴而為王侯，大而為郡牧，下而為庶民；文","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804535947935778"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":38,"lineType":2,"content":"於仁義忠信，富於財榖布帛；成而祀天地，靈而驅萬物，此人之事也。莫大乎天，莫厚乎地，莫靈于人。是以因于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":40,"lineType":2,"content":"天體，成于地儀，範圍天地之化，三才由　一而生也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"天一地二，蓋乾坤之體。坤為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"土也，乾為金，金亦土也，為水母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":42,"lineType":2,"content":"天一地二，奇耦之策也。三奇為乾，三耦為坤，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":44,"lineType":2,"content":"一而兩之之義也。故隂陽自始者，謂之太始；隂陽自明者，謂之太極。則萬物之始於乾也，亦由天地之所資以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":46,"lineType":2,"content":"始，是以知乾為之太始。萬物之所資生於坤也，亦由天地之所資以生，是以知坤為之太極。故乾之卦所以在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":48,"lineType":2,"content":"西北，坤之卦所以在西南，以乾為太始，以坤為太極，可知矣。是以太始之極，一而兩之，作乾坤之象。金土同體","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":50,"lineType":2,"content":"而異名，有此見一數之終始也矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"四正四隅，何遐邇之為正？艮為土也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"應乎坤。㢲為風也，風出木。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":52,"lineType":2,"content":"乾坤艮㢲，四隅也，而為天地之大紀。坎離震兑，四正也，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804535947952162"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":56,"lineType":2,"content":"為乾坤之大綱。曾不知廣輪之艮，而有㑹通之情也。然則萬物之始終，莫盛乎艮，故應乾坤之節制，莫始于㢲，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":58,"lineType":2,"content":"故為風。然風非出於木，而鼓舞於萬物為事，由動之生息也。故㢲繼於震。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"坎離未判，以清濁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"明水火；震兑之前，以左右用金木。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":60,"lineType":2,"content":"天一地六相合生水，地二天七相合生火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":62,"lineType":2,"content":"言水則含知而内明，言火則崇禮而外照。内明足以應物，外照足以知人。知人者無所不知，應物者無所不應。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":64,"lineType":2,"content":"故清之為水，得天一辰中，是奇内而天一，耦外而地六，其為卦也曰坎。故濁之為火，得地二辰中，是耦合而地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":66,"lineType":2,"content":"二，奇外而天七，其為卦也曰離。夫二者本水火南北之分，為乾坤男女之體，亦由清濁判於自然也。天三地八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":68,"lineType":2,"content":"相合而生木於東方，木生風以動之，故為卦曰震。地四天九相合而生金於西方，金生水以澤物，而物悦之，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":70,"lineType":2,"content":"為卦曰兑。然東木受西金之制，而左言木、右言金者，是震男兌女，尊𤰞之義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"易八卦者，以剛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804535947968546"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"柔相半；連四象者，分逆順而生成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":74,"lineType":2,"content":"易以八卦𠔥三才而兩立，為天地廣輪之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":76,"lineType":2,"content":"體用，故始三一而為乾二為坤，生六六九九之變為四𧰼五行之數，然後聖人分隂分陽，迭用柔剛以相易之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":78,"lineType":2,"content":"故天地位而成章也，列萬彚而象之，以别盛衰矣。四象者，大而為日月星辰，廣而為金木水火。八卦由四象而兩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":80,"lineType":2,"content":"制之，則有隂中之陽，陽中之隂，寒暑運行而萬物化育也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"二儀分列，各包四象之形；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤音土，遂作五行之用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":82,"lineType":2,"content":"天地為二儀，則上有日月星辰，運於無為，下有金木水火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":84,"lineType":2,"content":"濟於有用。金生於土而聚於土者。然乾坤本　一而立二，為清濁之别，包括四象為五行，以盡天地之數，備萬物","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":86,"lineType":2,"content":"之成終也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":86,"lineType":1,"content":"一而兩之，道法乎自然。八卦九宫，乘隂陽以數。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":86,"lineType":2,"content":"道生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":88,"lineType":2,"content":"一，一雖立而道未離也；　一生二，二名成而道斯逺矣。是故道非數而數之所生，　一非二而　一之所出。隂陽之在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804535947984930"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":92,"lineType":2,"content":"天地，其妙有機，而物之所始，其顯有數，而物之所生，始終如　一，　一有二而不可以相無。然隂雖有佐於陽，陽實","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":94,"lineType":2,"content":"始之而無恃焉；陽雖有賴於隂，隂實由之而不與焉。是陽常始而隂常成，陽常唱而隂常和，有自然之理。故陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":96,"lineType":2,"content":"奇隂耦，迭用生成，而天五地六，二五而成十。五十有五之䇿，所以行變化而明鬼神也。故乾坤之䇿，萬有一千","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":98,"lineType":2,"content":"五百二十，當期之日，當萬物之數，四營成易，十有八變成卦，發剛柔而生爻，以八八於四維，則居中者盡乎九","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":100,"lineType":2,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"五行分隂陽為十干，清而不下；五支易剛柔為十支，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"濁而不上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":102,"lineType":2,"content":"天地之數，各成於五，然始立甲者，本乎土之氣，申乾坤皆土之義，始於甲之丙丁，次生戊、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":104,"lineType":2,"content":"已庚、辛壬、癸，如一之有二，而為十干之氣主。曰清則騰而生，故不同下之五行也。五支，言道生　一而支散為五，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":106,"lineType":2,"content":"以成五行之數。乃濁者下沈而生二五如十，則分支列於乾坤之廣輪，如甲之生乙，丙之生丁之義。故寅則運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804535948001314"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":110,"lineType":2,"content":"於卯，巳則運於午，然而同類為隂陽，而不同支干之生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"土，逐四時之氣，故有十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"支。十二支以夫婦為體，十干以父子相乘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":112,"lineType":2,"content":"四時乃四季也，順四象之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":114,"lineType":2,"content":"用。然四象為兩，立成八支。惟土者本天地各五而兩之，則分四攴列乎四維，以終四象之變。盖辰戌同體，丑未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":116,"lineType":2,"content":"同形，子陽亥隂，寅陽卯隂之類，如夫婦之同體。甲生乙，乙生丙，𩔖如父子相生，本乎一而為五。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"三才有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":118,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽之天地，五行運物化之人倫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":118,"lineType":2,"content":"分隂陽則為天地，立父子則為人倫。故干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":120,"lineType":2,"content":"陽也，亦有乙丁巳辛癸之為隂；支，隂也，亦有子寅辰午申戌之為陽。是知隂陽之相覆，奇耦相匹，故萬物化成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":122,"lineType":2,"content":"生者為父為母為子為孫，配之為夫為婦，以別人倫之要也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰甲巳真宫，乙庚真","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"商，丙辛真羽，丁壬真角，戊癸真徵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":124,"lineType":2,"content":"甲木二　五之始，名而為土，六位相成於巳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804535948017698"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":128,"lineType":2,"content":"故曰真宫。土生始成終，故金次於土。羽，水之音；角，木之音；徵，火之音。此十干皆天之清氣，生數成於五，至六而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":130,"lineType":2,"content":"為耦，為隂陽之始，作天地之真運。然而真運在天，必自地而得之矣。何則？天罡本乎辰也，陽動而隂静，得十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":132,"lineType":2,"content":"常轉位，自甲子為始，至於辰則見戌，是地之功也。故甲之為土明矣。是知真運在天，自地而得之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"content":"戌火體，亥卯未木體，申子辰水體，已酉丑金體。斯非真體，乃五行生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":136,"lineType":1,"content":"旺庫之地，土則從四事成之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":136,"lineType":2,"content":"四象之體而終皆土，故戊至辛而金之土也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":136,"lineType":1,"content":"六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"十納音者，配由十干十二支，周而終之數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":138,"lineType":2,"content":"干支相乘，歸天地始","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":140,"lineType":2,"content":"終之數，為六十也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"自生成而言之，則水得一，火得二，木得三，金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":142,"lineType":1,"content":"得四，土得五。感物化而言之，則火得一，土得二，木得三，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804535948034082"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"金得四，水得五。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":146,"lineType":2,"content":"生成者，天地生成之數。物化則五行支干相成，納音之數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"法乎天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":148,"lineType":1,"content":"地，支干數乘，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":148,"lineType":2,"content":"此十干配天，十二支配地，而合成萬物動靜之機，充合端委之數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":148,"lineType":1,"content":"支干配，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":150,"lineType":1,"content":"則甲巳子午九，乙庚丑未八，丙辛寅申七，丁壬卯酉六，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"戊癸辰戌五，巳亥支數四。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":152,"lineType":2,"content":"自九之數，損之又損也。然於已亥者，不由巳而存乾之一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":154,"lineType":2,"content":"二，坤之二三，是道始一至三，錯綜而生諸數，以合乾坤覆載之功。若夫前所謂支干之配，則道生一，　一生二，二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":156,"lineType":2,"content":"生三，三之又三，則九為陽生。言數以甲巳為造化之首，子午為隂陽之至，取極之數，而先稱九，而後損之，八七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":158,"lineType":2,"content":"五六四也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"子寅同途，嵗上辰下，未可俱言其支。先甲後子，納","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":160,"lineType":1,"content":"音金者，數也。始父母之氣而成音，離天地則見名數。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":160,"lineType":2,"content":"子得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804535948050466"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":164,"lineType":2,"content":"同壬，寅得同甲，嵗木辰水，如寅為木二合，若見子而得寅者，亦是甲子之金，不可獨言木也。甲臨於子而金者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":166,"lineType":2,"content":"是支干化納音之數也。干支五行始因天五地五之數，變而納音九八七六五四之數相成上下而得，却須坎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":168,"lineType":2,"content":"離五六之數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"天五地五則為造化之先，除其數則納音之用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":170,"lineType":2,"content":"天地變通，二五為十，終成萬物。始一終五皆陽，合之為六，則隂為六五數外即天地數所納五行之數也。假令","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":172,"lineType":2,"content":"水得五者，是本音，以土權碍也，然後有音，故丙子丁丑共，得三十之數，而六五皆土，而得納音為水也。火得一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":174,"lineType":2,"content":"者，是火無音，因水沃之，然後有音，故戊子巳丑共，得三十一數，而除六五而有一數，而納音得火也。木得三者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":176,"lineType":2,"content":"蓋木有本音，故壬子癸丑共，得二十八數，而有五之數，是三數，而納音得木也。金得四者，亦金是本音，而甲子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":178,"lineType":2,"content":"乙丑共，得三十四數，而除六五之數外，是四數乃金也。土得二者，盖土本無音，火陶之，然後有音，故庚子辛丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804535948066850"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":182,"lineType":2,"content":"共，得三十二數，而除五六之數，而納音為土也。故經云先甲後子，納音金者，數也，得此則彼可知也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"自乾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":184,"lineType":1,"content":"而生順，從坤而産逆。隂陽機括於五行，五行之體依八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"卦，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":186,"lineType":2,"content":"父生順，母生逆。假如甲巳干正月建丙寅，丙丁火，故木生順母，巳之干在木死為逆，故甲為父，已為母。在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":188,"lineType":2,"content":"寅之家，天一生水，則由乾為屬金。金水也。故自乾生而順及納音，即甲子乙丑金為首。盖乾納甲子，即是天五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":190,"lineType":2,"content":"地五於坤數中生，逆其終數而生，亦由先九而後至四數也。隂陽者乾坤，故金土　一而兩之，以備五行。五行分","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":192,"lineType":2,"content":"體用而為八卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"火愛乾為㑹，水利㢲而享嵗，守坤鄉，金蔵艮位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":194,"lineType":2,"content":"乾純陽也，處西北，故至亥而顯明。水性本下，㢲出東南，順下也，故水已為利也。坤則成物，嵗以終之，故至中萬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":196,"lineType":2,"content":"物介然守禮。用艮終始萬物而仕於坤，故金至寅終蔵於土下。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"木落糞本，水流趨末，火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804535948083234"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"顯諸用，金蔽於光，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":200,"lineType":2,"content":"各任性鄉，故守坤鄉。水趨末則利㢲方，火顯用則愛於乾，金蔽於光則又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":202,"lineType":2,"content":"蔵於艮也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"水土金性本下，木火性本巍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":202,"lineType":2,"content":"水流就濕，土積而載，金重而沉，故曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":204,"lineType":2,"content":"本下。巍者，上也。木性漸上，而火性炎上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":204,"lineType":1,"content":"沈者得形而上騰，升者期𤰞而髙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":206,"lineType":2,"content":"水得土而木生，是土克水而生木。木之克土而上騰，則水土之氣自木而上也。火得水而上為既濟。蓋推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":208,"lineType":2,"content":"五行之性，沉者升者，皆必以形為用也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":208,"lineType":1,"content":"以坎為離，精玄者能知。易兑作震，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"通鬼神而作㫖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":210,"lineType":2,"content":"庚申辛酉木在巳申酉之中，亦當作金或卯。人遇三酉之𩔖而可言金，餘准此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":212,"lineType":2,"content":"推之，則妙窮造化，但以本納音為用，所謂易兑作震，通鬼神而作㫖，此也。假令丙午水得癸已月丙寅日戊戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":214,"lineType":2,"content":"時，已午未為火之本方，寅戌午之正體。又上下俱火，雖納音為水，多變作炎上之火看。或水多人全在巳午未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804535948099618"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":218,"lineType":2,"content":"生而不犯本命支，更干頭有氣，亦宜作火看，不可謂之休囚。此所謂以坎為離，精𤣥妙者為能知，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":218,"lineType":1,"content":"故以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":220,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申乙卯為夫婦之本宗。子癸亥壬丁馬丙蛇之寄位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":222,"lineType":2,"content":"此論干祿也。季主所謂先南北之陽，以辨東西之隂，隂祿陽而陽祿隂，金自金而木自木，故金木自然而得専","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":224,"lineType":2,"content":"位。水火上從造化，故陽寄於隂，而隂寄陽也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"勞而不息，驛居病方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":224,"lineType":2,"content":"五行支病處而為驛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":226,"lineType":2,"content":"驛所以休息也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"馬得縱横。更觀乎干生而不運，以氣建推之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":226,"lineType":2,"content":"以申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":228,"lineType":2,"content":"子辰水位處驛為病也。以寅為驛，所謂馬必以氣建者，而驛之為馬也。且甲子人正月丙為馬，然不在正月，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":230,"lineType":2,"content":"自得地位，建丙亦是馬，故曰馬得縱横矣。珞琭子云：見不見之形，無時不有。正謂此也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"出五行之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"外者，生死在乎我；居清濁之內者，存亡從數焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":232,"lineType":2,"content":"凡修徳養性，煉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804535948116002"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":236,"lineType":2,"content":"假守真，靈臺内靜，反復還元，神遊六合之外，必造五行之先，則欲生欲死、欲隱欲顯，皆由乎我，是謂神仙真人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":238,"lineType":2,"content":"矣。豈由天地、鬼神、時數所拘哉？此欲人之自修，不可専滯乎命。彼生死猶可任，况修徳致祥，轉禍為福。夫人居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":240,"lineType":2,"content":"清濁之内，皆由情性、善惡、死生，而未能逃五行之數者，何也？蓋未嘗能煉陽純隂，煉隂純陽，雖存念至道，亦不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":242,"lineType":2,"content":"能出於清濁之間，徒自苦形而不逃存亡之數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"元命勝負三元者，干祿、支命、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"納音身各分衰旺之地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":244,"lineType":2,"content":"三元各分生旺庫之地，而為九命，是主祿主三㑹也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"干主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"名祿貴權，為衣食受用之基；支主金珠積富，為得失榮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"枯之本；納音主材能器識，為人倫親屬之宗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":248,"lineType":2,"content":"干為天元祿，故主貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":250,"lineType":2,"content":"爵，衣食之正本也；支為地元財命至此比形立象，始終之元，故主貧富、運動、榮枯。納音為人元身命，故主賢愚、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804535948132386"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":254,"lineType":2,"content":"好醜、形貌、材能、度量。凡有生則彼我生尅、愛憎，故為人倫親眷也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"支干納音之氣，順四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"柱以定休囚；祿馬神煞之方，分二儀以求勝負。刼灾天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":258,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗遇用處不能為凶；祿馬奇轝逢破處未始為福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":258,"lineType":2,"content":"三元五行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":260,"lineType":2,"content":"亦各分四季，定休旺之氣。干中所用神煞，乃天之清氣；攴中所用神煞，乃地之濁氣。凡言神煞，各分天地二氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":262,"lineType":2,"content":"勝負吉凶，支煞自有諸例。言刼災天嵗，四煞雖凶，若支干配合有用，則為福祿之神。禄馬奇轝雖干之清氣，富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":264,"lineType":2,"content":"貴之神，主福祿尊貴，若支神配合為破敗者，則反為貧賤凶害之煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱者，胎月日時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":264,"lineType":2,"content":"三元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":266,"lineType":2,"content":"為萬物之本，四柱乃五行之輔佐，亦猶乾坤之有四時，土有四𧰼，人有四肢。故珞琭子云根在苗先，實從花後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":268,"lineType":2,"content":"者。四柱有偏枯，則隨所主而論之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"胎主父母祖宗者十分，主事者二分。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804535948148770"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":272,"lineType":2,"content":"萬物之根本，固在我名之先有也，故主祖宗者十分。然而根在物之先，而花實苗之後，雖主事二分，亦當以胎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":274,"lineType":2,"content":"為本氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"月主時氣者十分，主事者六分。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":274,"lineType":2,"content":"月為建元，分四時之休旺，故主三元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":276,"lineType":2,"content":"氣用所出十分，是月與時為賓主，以輔三元，故主立氣立事十分，是將來臨月分，亦定灾福之六分。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"日主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"未得氣者十分，主事者八分。時主用度進退向背力氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"勝負皆十分，吉與凶同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":280,"lineType":2,"content":"日主月内四時向背之氣十分，三元貴賤之氣及胎本共時八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":282,"lineType":2,"content":"分。時主元吉凶及胎月日之氣皆十分。故言吉凶變異，勝負之力同等也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"九命論互相奔刑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"反順生煞，以别源流。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":284,"lineType":2,"content":"三元四柱祿馬為九命，須遞相往來，取刑衝徳合、逆順盛衰，以定清","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":286,"lineType":2,"content":"濁之理。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"先看重輕盛衰，尊𤰞逆順，次分彼我𦂳慢，情意相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804535948165154"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":290,"lineType":1,"content":"續。干音親義四柱，然不合衝𩔖干頭配合之理。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":290,"lineType":2,"content":"先看三元支干本意，以辨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":292,"lineType":2,"content":"四柱之力。有形，視形氣之厚薄。凡化象之有性，操用度之淺深。勿論得地不得地，辨尊𤰞之勝負也。四柱相衝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":294,"lineType":2,"content":"然無配合。納音取賓主，保義情親，以定勝負。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵年為本，則日為主，月為使，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"則時為輔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":296,"lineType":2,"content":"年為日之本，日為命主，如君之有臣，父之有子，夫之有婦，國之有王。是胎月生時，為主本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":298,"lineType":2,"content":"之扶援，欲得以序相承順也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"主本保合，未有貧賤之人。時日乖違，豈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"有久榮之理。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":300,"lineType":2,"content":"主本保和，相育為貴。年尅日，減力也。日尅年，雖主 甲畏辛，見乙畏酉，金火畏死地逢子也。又如戊逢癸亥，是干正支邪。戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":316,"lineType":2,"content":"午、丙子，支正干邪。然水火隂陽相和，則不如干合為正也。又如丙辰見申為祿衰，土逢壬為鬼。丁人見乙卯、癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":318,"lineType":2,"content":"卯之𩔖，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"必死有生，凶中反吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":318,"lineType":2,"content":"如庚子見丁卯，死而得生。甲子見戊寅，凶中反吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":320,"lineType":1,"content":"衰之理，審量生尅；輕重之名，須識向背。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":320,"lineType":2,"content":"三元旺地畏忌，衰處好生。湏臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":322,"lineType":2,"content":"時審其輕重。如壬申癸酉本重，壬寅癸卯本輕，却取輕重扶持為用，始分向背之力氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":322,"lineType":1,"content":"輕得地而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804535948197922"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"可敵重衰，重無地而制之輕敗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":326,"lineType":2,"content":"如土制水，則丙辰丁巳之土，能制丙子癸亥之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":328,"lineType":2,"content":"水也。壬申癸酉之金雖重，却遇戊子巳丑丙寅丁卯之火，雖金重，亦受制於火。蓋火向旺，金絶方也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"各衰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":n
