eId":"331","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"金得火多，則口才辯利，好禮忘義，動止寛和，中心鄙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"吝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":402,"lineType":2,"content":"火勝於金，有義禮也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"金得水多，則計慮不深，為人無恩，臨事齷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"齪，或是或非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":404,"lineType":2,"content":"水重金蔵，多計無剛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"金得土多，則失中有成，口儉心","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"慈，作為暗昧，多處嫌疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":406,"lineType":2,"content":"金蔽土中，則求之者成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"土得土多，則重厚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"蔵密，守信容物，或招毁謗，恩害敢為。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":408,"lineType":2,"content":"土雖守信，深厚難知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"土得金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":410,"lineType":1,"content":"多，則信而好義，剛而多躁，不能持重，庶事無容。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":410,"lineType":2,"content":"金土爭麗，兩不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":412,"lineType":2,"content":"自持。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"土得木多，則形勞志大，雜好狂徒，用柔爽信，曲直黨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804535948279842"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":416,"lineType":2,"content":"木尅土則信虧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"土得火多，則施義忘親，外明少斷，奢儉失中，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"好禮口𠅤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":418,"lineType":2,"content":"土得火助，信有所毁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"土得水多，則貪功好進，汎順伏機，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"355","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"志善若昏，愛惡無義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":421,"lineType":2,"content":"土雖尅水，水多則土失信。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"誠能以此更分輕重，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"明作為之性情，消息盈虚，依於禍福，然後為能言。以前","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"五行多寡論性情，而復推禍福。正氣無刑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":425,"lineType":2,"content":"如庚祿在申，氣當用甲，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":427,"lineType":2,"content":"諸位中不見庚之刑甲，或他位見甲，即為無庚是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"名背之半，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":427,"lineType":2,"content":"不見正祿，如得已而無乙，亦是所謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":429,"lineType":2,"content":"得一分三之説。雖背正祿，必為福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"馬無害，祿無鬼，食無亡，支合無元，干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"祿無厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":431,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲子得丙寅為馬，見壬午及水在丙寅六合破刑之上，如不見正氣，却見他干在祿位，其祿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804535948296226"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":435,"lineType":2,"content":"干亦要無鬼也。倒食順食，皆要無空亡，亡神也。支神名合要無元辰，十干合處要無六厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"旺無䘮，衰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"無弔，妻無刃，財無飛，孟無孤，季無寡，生無刼，死無敗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":437,"lineType":2,"content":"如癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":439,"lineType":2,"content":"丑木命不要卯，此則旺無䘮。如壬午木命不要辰，此則衰無弔。陽制隂，為妻不可在羊刃上，故妻欲無刃。命後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":441,"lineType":2,"content":"四辰曰飛廉，我尅者為財，不可犯之。四孟之人不得見孤辰在命，四季之人不得見孤宿在地。長生處要不值","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":443,"lineType":2,"content":"刼煞，如乙巳、丁酉、乙丑見寅是也。死處忌見八敗。沐浴金神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"火無水，水無土，土無木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"木湏金，金湏火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":445,"lineType":2,"content":"火無水降，亦能自潤。水無土壅，莫不成流，土無木制，曠野安然。木湏金尅，可以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":447,"lineType":2,"content":"成材，金無火鍜，不能成器。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"體重湏鬼，祿輕湏官，刑雖全，敗雖孤，夫湏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":449,"lineType":1,"content":"尠，妻湏倍，吉湏顯煞，凶湏沉昧，天盤湏㑹，地帶湏連。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":449,"lineType":2,"content":"五行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804535948312610"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":453,"lineType":2,"content":"本重，湏鬼損裁。禄輕湏官，如甲人祿位，雖辛亦貴。四柱之刑，各湏全見。八敗之地，不畏本氣在孤病。夫湏尠者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":455,"lineType":2,"content":"已不可見甲衆也。妻湏倍者，甲見已在旺地也。五行在吉神方，湏顯然，見其清氣。凶位見五行，湏得凶煞沉昧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":457,"lineType":2,"content":"斯能無害。甲丙庚壬，湏左右朝揖，是天盤湏㑹也。亥子丑寅卯，須交連左右，是地帶湏連也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"干全順","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"則為清，氣完和者為貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":459,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲乙丙丁戊為十干，全湏嵗胎月日時順則為清，如水在申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":461,"lineType":2,"content":"子辰中，或在亥子丑中，制用氣完乃為貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"隂附陽帶嵗則富貴，陽合隂背本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"則虚浮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":463,"lineType":2,"content":"陽支互合，隂干不來朝命，及本向衰，則無有用也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"應凶觀空而無空，旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"相得空而尤利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":465,"lineType":2,"content":"應煞害刑在空亡無合，動不為凶也。旺相處明暗合，或逢天月徳見空亡亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":467,"lineType":1,"content":"至若空亡有用，賴虚中而有應。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":467,"lineType":2,"content":"夫響之有聲，莫非中虚也。至若鐘鼓之聲，虚中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804535948328994"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":471,"lineType":2,"content":"則擊而鳴逺，若實之則不應。是以大人之命要虚中，徳必居空，空自旺有用，乃有大聲之應器也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"庫中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼勿取，生旺繼衰殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":473,"lineType":2,"content":"當生旺者，更引旺處，福與禍併。庫中之鬼，如甲見辛未，金見已丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"木本離而化薪，金趨坎而育水。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":475,"lineType":2,"content":"木見火多，或木重運至離宫，則化柴薪也。雖金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":477,"lineType":2,"content":"生於水，然子勝而母負也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"水有火，火有金，金有木，木有土，土有水。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":477,"lineType":2,"content":"如壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":479,"lineType":2,"content":"中有丁，丙中有辛，庚中有乙，甲中有已，戊中有癸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"干備而祿備，命成而財成，身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"有地而官行，貴賤自此而見矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":481,"lineType":2,"content":"干為天祿，要正氣而有地，備足貴扶之類。支為命，納","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":483,"lineType":2,"content":"音為身。身命順旺，財在中也。又能先論納音輕重，而分干祿命財，更身有命，則貴可知也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"祿為君子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":485,"lineType":1,"content":"之性，命為定性，身為用性。時納音為居性，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":485,"lineType":2,"content":"言性則可至於命。祿主貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804535948345378"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":489,"lineType":2,"content":"故為君子之性。支為定局，取其屬以見人之定性。納音主財，能𠾖為川性也。有時則三元之氣備，所以見人居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":491,"lineType":2,"content":"止動靜情性也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"貴氣無地賤生，貴中本賤。有時貴生賤内。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":491,"lineType":2,"content":"本於日時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":493,"lineType":2,"content":"上旺相保和，却得貴氣來時上衰敗，始貴終賤。四柱落在貧賤氣中，而時運在旺方逢時之貴氣，賤中反貴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"貴絶處觀殃，因貴賤中亡。賤臨貴鬼旺，賤向貴中死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":495,"lineType":2,"content":"貴備","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":497,"lineType":2,"content":"之氣至絶處更帶鬼，雖貴人死於終賤。主本賤臨鬼旺，而有鬼氣來承，雖賤而後亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"支干太和","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"而塞，夫婦失時而凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":499,"lineType":2,"content":"五行支干納音専位相和則蹇剥。如甲子逢已，巳在秋生，又見甲午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":501,"lineType":2,"content":"衝命，兩金尅已。已，木也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"三元有地而貴，四柱遞合而崇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":501,"lineType":2,"content":"三元俱有用，得地必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":503,"lineType":2,"content":"富貴清顯。胎月日時，交互相合而朝命，即是崇貴相輔清顯之命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804535948361762"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"真假邪正，　變通拙而蔽於神，執一明而瞽於衆。辨明","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"真假，消息盈虛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":509,"lineType":2,"content":"隂陽無形，為道至妙，湏在智識變通為比。察觀真假，消息盈虚，則𤫊於神明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"守位則正，失方則邪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":511,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲寅乙卯在亥卯未，乃得正體。若居巳酉丑之方，謂之失位。他皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":513,"lineType":2,"content":"倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"隂生陽死，逆順相因。甲氣申方，乙絶酉位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":513,"lineType":2,"content":"四時一陽生，六隂死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":515,"lineType":2,"content":"然陽道行左，隂道行右。如甲乙皆木也，甲陽生亥，而順行至午則死。乙隂在午，而逆行至酉為絶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"子為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"天正，嵗時始於一陽。寅為地首，陽備人興于甲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":517,"lineType":2,"content":"建子之月，一陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":519,"lineType":2,"content":"生焉，是為嵗首。則一日建子，子時當為一日之首。建寅之月，草木甲拆，則陽氣備，嵗時興。建寅之時，則人興寢，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":521,"lineType":2,"content":"日事始，非天道之始，為地首矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":521,"lineType":1,"content":"天左中而左吉，地右半而坤鄉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":521,"lineType":2,"content":"太陽法天，正月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804535948378146"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":525,"lineType":2,"content":"自子左行，至六月在未，未，小吉也，以是子為天正也。月建法地，自正月建寅，至六月在未，未，坤之境也。而天地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":527,"lineType":2,"content":"異見而至同焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"先天後地，宫土其中，人中貴神丑上已土。正體","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"大吉，形體小吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":529,"lineType":2,"content":"言天自子行，太陽至未，如月建至寅然，往而中㑹於未，終於丑，故宫土其中也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":531,"lineType":2,"content":"天地自寅子左右行，至中而終於丑，常中於地之道者，未有人中之貴神。丑為大吉，未為小吉，已同丑未之體，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":533,"lineType":2,"content":"左右天地，中㑹其方，小吉，所以立貴神用已丑為家也。夫貴神者，在天為紫微星，在地為天乙貴神，領諸干神，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":535,"lineType":2,"content":"助地旋徳，奉天行道，以及乎人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"戌亥為天之成，辰已為地之往。故貴神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"逢天則左，遇地則右。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":537,"lineType":2,"content":"言亥為地之隂極，戌為天之神極，守萬物成功卑用之位，是謂天之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":539,"lineType":2,"content":"成也已，乃地之陽極，辰為天隂之始，是萬物榮枯往來進功。又戌為魁成，辰為罔幹，故貴神逢天地真運，進退","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804535948394530"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":543,"lineType":2,"content":"之所，領諸神避之。故逢天則左行，遇地則右行也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"天乙不守魁罡，庚辛隂陽合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"異。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":545,"lineType":2,"content":"天罡、天魁，是天地造化立事營始成終之位。二辰主生殺之權，行刑政之統。天乙紫微以吉徳善輔，行道","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":547,"lineType":2,"content":"而不亂典彝，行令而不殺戮。惟以正道尊嚴天徳，故分旦暮之位，以别相儀，隂陽之卜，以當進退。人能審是，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":549,"lineType":2,"content":"見五行盈虚之異用矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"魁為大煞，正月厭元，亥為地將，正期神合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":551,"lineType":2,"content":"魁主肅殺揫歛之辰，寅為和氣生育之首。故正月生體，以九月為厭元，亥為登明，正月將與合徳期合也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"徳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"將無厭，清華總領之人；徳合月承，金殿鳳臺之貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":553,"lineType":2,"content":"亥人正月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":555,"lineType":2,"content":"生，得亥而無戌。又此月生人，天徳在丁，月徳在丙，更與四柱徳合。若人生有天月二徳，朝命承之，必歴顯位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":557,"lineType":1,"content":"金堅於土，乾坤妙用無方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":557,"lineType":2,"content":"金土　一也，主色麗而堅剛於土。陽自隂生而尊於陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":557,"lineType":1,"content":"土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805435541094400"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"重而金生，金强而育水，水流而嵗成，木交而火熾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":561,"lineType":2,"content":"清者自濁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":563,"lineType":2,"content":"而澄，靜者乃動之機，是土重則金生矣。濕生土，土生金，故云金生水。水實地中行，非假金，故云金土　一也。水既","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":565,"lineType":2,"content":"生旺，則木榮長矣。木相摩而火熾，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"火無我也。夫薪歸土，火遇土不能生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼在旺方，看五行之輕重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":567,"lineType":2,"content":"火無相，托物現形，故謂之神。青赤而為父子，故火無木則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":569,"lineType":2,"content":"化灰塵也。盈虚相代，逆順相成，未始有生，未始有死，綿綿無窮，妙應無方，用之不匱，乃五行之隂陽，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"測於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"無形，不執乎相，乃得真際。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":571,"lineType":2,"content":"五行支干，相因而生納音，五行周運無窮。隂陽之道，不見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":573,"lineType":2,"content":"聲形，無以比擬。執相之論，直湏盡神，攄披變通，乃不亂用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"或有陽守隂多而利，隂逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"陽盛而殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":575,"lineType":2,"content":"一者衆之歸，故陽多得隂而利，隂𤰞而陽盛，故一隂衆陽，必多殃競。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"日遇隔角","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805435541110784"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"孤有用，陽就妻而成家。婦若奔夫。二位雖貴，合六馬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":579,"lineType":2,"content":"以年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":581,"lineType":2,"content":"為夫，以日為婦。如日在孤絶隔角，却於年上有吉神之氣，宜陽就隂為吉。如甲辰得巳酉，是陽不往合其隂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":583,"lineType":2,"content":"為婦奔夫，禮所屈也。若已丑合甲子，是夫位有貴神，財命進旺，故從夫也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"先上清而得之下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"濁，後下濁而升越上清。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":585,"lineType":2,"content":"先取上之輕清為用神之福。次看濁氣居下，上雖清而不秀，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":587,"lineType":2,"content":"取下濁有用之氣，為福所升越為上矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子、已丑是天地合，輕重自分。丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"亥壬辰清潔㑹，支干尤亨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":589,"lineType":2,"content":"彼我往來，皆在囚死，故雖有貴者，不能㧞萃，猶不若巳丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":591,"lineType":2,"content":"見甲子是也。丁亥地貴符，壬辰禄清潔。丁壬合氣為木，生於亥，而更辰與亥為秀徳合貴氣互换，乃清潔也。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":593,"lineType":2,"content":"壬辰生而得丁亥，未為盡善。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":593,"lineType":1,"content":"寅中有甲，得隂土以為妻，方知甲與已","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805435541127168"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"合。丑寅未㑹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":597,"lineType":2,"content":"甲乙、寅未相合，甲寅同體，丑未同巳，故寅見丑未為合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"子已體壬丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"之會，卯申同乙庚之交。丙午辛酉無干不為破刑。癸始","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"亥中，辰戌得同乎戊。此乃有無之相承，異乎六合之配","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"偶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":603,"lineType":2,"content":"此言皆天地同道而分一二三生，而隂陽數異而為支干，故同體者支配干合矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"同形則貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"在巖廊，六合或清居邦教。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":605,"lineType":2,"content":"辰亥子巳之數，皆同形之合，故貴而遇者必髙大。六合専","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":607,"lineType":2,"content":"位，貴為清選。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"連屬不言孤寡，清絶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":607,"lineType":2,"content":"一作純粹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"可勝乖違。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":607,"lineType":2,"content":"如亥得寅戌，寅見丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":609,"lineType":2,"content":"未，或支干朝㑹，包裹貴人，連屬本命，雖犯孤寡亦吉。如壬辰丁亥、甲午已未，雖主木乖違，却有清純秀氣，可以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":611,"lineType":2,"content":"為福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":611,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡多取真形，慎勿専持假體。寅午戌氣禧於申，更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805435541143552"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"觀干頭之輕重。合守安馬於戌，全要無形。土馬守於離，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"陽晶應於子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":617,"lineType":2,"content":"五行支干配用，先推真者為用，則五行之妙見也。火體氣病散禧於申。湏看干頭所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":619,"lineType":2,"content":"配生殺三支輕重，以論乎吉凶。三合季地乃華盖下之暗馬，㑹之者亦當富貴。大忌衝破之處，土無正氣，寄於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":621,"lineType":2,"content":"離火為精神，而祿應於子也，則土水為夫婦，由水之於火，正守子午之位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"三元失地，雖貴而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"弗貴。上下得真，雖賤而未賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":623,"lineType":2,"content":"三元失地，雖貴者必遭貶而不康寧。如甲子得壬子、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":625,"lineType":2,"content":"已丑、甲寅、乙卯、癸亥、戊辰，乃天地之吉氣，雖賤而不知𤰞矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋陽盛則禧陽，隂極則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"殺隂是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":627,"lineType":2,"content":"隂陽各得専位，而不為遇極，雖身受死絶，亦有富貴之理。凡論隂陽勝負，必分真假邪正，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":629,"lineType":2,"content":"斯可矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805435541159936"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"升降清濁　父子之行年同體，子享父利。夫婦之祿馬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"併傷，妻殃夫病。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":635,"lineType":2,"content":"年父時子生我為父，尅我為子，二者氣用在行年上分吉凶，各隨其用，以分休","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":637,"lineType":2,"content":"咎。年祿日馬日祿年馬，各有時害，則夫婦併傷也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"五墓為嵗蔵之地，時貴亦妨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"四孟是孤絶之方，帶煞必尅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":639,"lineType":2,"content":"四季為五行之墓，萬物之所終也。生時逢之，雖會吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":641,"lineType":2,"content":"而貴，亦主妨害尊親也。四孟上有孤辰氣絶，若更見亡神、刼煞、嵗刑，亦主妨害父母也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"子午乃隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"陽之至，卯酉為日月之門。死敗全逢，刑猶夀考。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":643,"lineType":2,"content":"四仲時生，主無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":645,"lineType":2,"content":"妨敗。若年死敗有生，主有夀及父母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"有祿者，干支生成，動則周觀；闕祿者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"財命身祿，行游一理。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":647,"lineType":2,"content":"干祿破傷，五行不秀。湏推財命，不可一揆，推其官鬼。至於行運，亦不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805435541176320"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":651,"lineType":2,"content":"論干頭祿馬矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"祿位有無，認於官鬼。官鬼競馳，災殃併亂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":651,"lineType":2,"content":"身有地，祿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":653,"lineType":2,"content":"氣無刑，更要干中無官鬼。有官鬼，雖貴而多殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"身土遇火生而漸利。命水得金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"降而優長。金多湏火，或從革以成名。木重得金，揉曲直","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"而任使。水流不止，息土以攘之。火盛無依，惟水以濟之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":659,"lineType":2,"content":"生命喜於生旺，祿干不嫌尅制。金重無火，而集旺於酉中，亦可以成名。木重湏金，如無金而亥卯未，亦為曲直","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":661,"lineType":2,"content":"理斷之任使。水流不止，惟土以防之。水流不進，欲以土尅發，仍有水土之輕重。如火之盛旺，左右無木，須得水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":663,"lineType":2,"content":"制，方成既濟，使不極也。火輕則不然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅丁卯，秋冬宜以保持。戊午庚申，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":665,"lineType":1,"content":"彼我得之超異。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":665,"lineType":2,"content":"木不南奔，火無西旺，故火木至秋冬，勢恐不久。庚申石榴木夏旺，故喜戊午，盖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805435541192704"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":669,"lineType":2,"content":"天官旺而石榴之木性得時。戊午乃旺極之火氣，喜於甲見，天馬相資也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"時居日祿，當得路","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"於青雲，五馬交加，可致身於黄閣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":671,"lineType":2,"content":"生月生日，兩禄干在時，如敏少宰已已年、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":673,"lineType":2,"content":"已巳月、已已日、庚午時是也。注云：甲日得寅時，須有氣而能朝命，主本三無氣，亦可清貴，但夀福不永耳。年月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":675,"lineType":2,"content":"日時胎五馬不閑，定為文儒之貴。若年馬、時馬、華盖馬及二位天馬不閑亦是。如王安中左丞，乙卯年、丁亥月、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":677,"lineType":2,"content":"乙已日、丁亥時是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"丁壬喜乎丙辛，乙庚愛乎甲已，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":677,"lineType":2,"content":"言彼有此辨。一分氣是得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":679,"lineType":2,"content":"一分三之義，乃氣相生也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午愛官旺，辛酉忌生旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":679,"lineType":2,"content":"强悍砂洑之金，欲得官鬼有生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":681,"lineType":2,"content":"旺之氣，亦可為貴旺，不必為官也。辛酉氣絶之木，欲生旺以為榮。然金中之木，金木未成器，為貴美亦可矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":683,"lineType":1,"content":"物之未閧，盛衰有漸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":683,"lineType":2,"content":"物生有漸則堅實。盖其進鋭者其退速。是以五行之命，貴在中庸之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805435541209088"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":687,"lineType":2,"content":"氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"以慶為吉慶弗吉，知凶逺凶凶敗無。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":687,"lineType":2,"content":"作福作威，返福為禍。知命畏天，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":689,"lineType":2,"content":"轉禍為福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"有根而無苗，實貧而尚可甘飡。本氣絶而花繁，縱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"子成而味拙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":691,"lineType":2,"content":"根基主本有氣，雖食運不扶合，亦可作六親優備，平生自足之命。三元四柱本無旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":693,"lineType":2,"content":"氣，得到福祿之運，亦乍舉乍勝，不可以大榮達也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"君子小人之用，否泰各端。支","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"煞納音之情，體何一揆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":695,"lineType":2,"content":"攴干配祿馬貴神，君子之事也。納音財帛支煞，小人之用也。乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":697,"lineType":2,"content":"分君子小人兩端推之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申已亥生成而有子有孫。祿命身源衰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"旺而存終辨始。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":699,"lineType":2,"content":"四孟上見四柱之生旺，更不必推，乃有子有孫也。又説湏是六合相合方論此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":701,"lineType":2,"content":"如見六害，却無息也。如癸亥年、庚申月、壬寅日、乙巳時，却無嗣。先看三元輕重，次看四柱盛衰。既見主本髙低，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805435541225472"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":705,"lineType":2,"content":"乃論運中得失。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"順往而亨，逆者則否。逆順之情，從大小運而言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":707,"lineType":2,"content":"言三元分於四柱，要互换生旺，然後以九命看二運上，要休旺相順為吉，勝負相逆為否。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"智仁禮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"信義水木火土金論十二數者，支干極也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":709,"lineType":2,"content":"水即言智，木則近仁，火則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":711,"lineType":2,"content":"主禮，土則主信，金則主義。以支干相配，五行各有十　二位也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"智仁則清，禮義則濁。信","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"從四時之氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":713,"lineType":2,"content":"水木和柔，主文章清秀；金火剛暴，主威武濁勇。土隨四時而有濁有清，當隨所犯而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":715,"lineType":2,"content":"言之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"清無地而後濁，濁有時而返清。清得地而轉清，濁會","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"濁而愈濁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":717,"lineType":2,"content":"水木失地，雖貴必俗，濁而為武人。金火得四時之生旺氣，反清貴，而主文章繼世，為天下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":719,"lineType":2,"content":"英賢秀士。如木生亥卯未，而有水生之性也。金水有用，可武耀於疆場，為天下元帥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":719,"lineType":1,"content":"旺相之義。官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805435541241856"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼豈分清濁之源，輕重可别。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":723,"lineType":2,"content":"戊午火旺盛，見木水相乘，則官在其間也。如無水木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":725,"lineType":2,"content":"即湏見祿。水木金火各先分所得納音之氣輕重，然後論所得之地，以辨輕重清濁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"應得墓者，守","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"成而無害。臨生旺者，自損抑則崇性。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":727,"lineType":2,"content":"凡得五行在墓，其中見財富官貴者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":729,"lineType":2,"content":"發旺，即巳當功成身退，守之乃榮。本末皆旺，而運氣更臨生旺，是人富貴得時者，宜自謙退。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"祿馬氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"聚，刑備貴全。清則清貴，濁則濁榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":731,"lineType":2,"content":"祿馬在身命之刑位者。若見貴人，全聚徳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":733,"lineType":2,"content":"合，生氣聚旺，不論清濁，皆主富貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"偶者則升，孤者則降。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":733,"lineType":2,"content":"支干祿㑹，福祿集聚，則升清為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":735,"lineType":2,"content":"上格。如不得天元一氣，若又支干孤絶，正氣刑破，却逢身㑹旺相有貴者，當降為下品之格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"徳將相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":737,"lineType":1,"content":"扶，金印垂腰之貴，遞相揖讓調鼎，位極人臣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":737,"lineType":2,"content":"天月徳臨月將事合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805435541258240"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":741,"lineType":2,"content":"神，乃主紫綬金章之貴。支干六合清氣合四柱，支干左右朝命柱者，乃極品之貴人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":6,"lineType":1,"content":"衰旺取時　論：一方之氣不可過角，進角為孤，退角為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":8,"lineType":1,"content":"寡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":8,"lineType":2,"content":"一方之氣，則四象各主于一時之偶也，如寅卯辰則已孤丑寡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":8,"lineType":1,"content":"既旺不過一方之氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"却言衰者，成功也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":10,"lineType":2,"content":"木水亥衰於辰，是木出東方春位而衰，此本末衰旺，功成身退，子結花落","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":12,"lineType":2,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"華過衰而實成，是窮則變通之象。始生於沐浴，為風","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"水陶化之因。冠帶則材器可任，臨官則鬼害之難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":14,"lineType":2,"content":"物主臨官，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":16,"lineType":2,"content":"則氣血堅壯，可受制敵，不畏其鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"旺則剛介自處，衰則去華立實。病者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892072087595"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"孤也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":20,"lineType":2,"content":"病者形勢孤弱，如木病巳，則寅辰之孤也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"死兮無物。墓蔵為造化之終，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"絶煞有鼎新之氣，氣盡後成胞胎凝結，始分形狀，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":22,"lineType":2,"content":"此長生之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":24,"lineType":2,"content":"氣。言五行至絶，受氣而成形，十二攴位之理，乃代謝自然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"夫物出自然，端倪莫測，直","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"須仔細探賾，消息龜數，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":26,"lineType":2,"content":"五行之造化，萬物之盈虧，以盡蓍龜之數。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"衰病之所，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"有鬼則止，無鬼則停。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":28,"lineType":2,"content":"止則窮已，停則流滯。如丙至壬戌、壬申則絶，至庚申、乙亥，則流滯而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":30,"lineType":2,"content":"不通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"30","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"水性本寒，火體本熱，極寒則丑寅以為期，大暑則未申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"而自定。極也，反也，五行之常體；生也，殞也，萬物之自然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892072103979"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":38,"lineType":2,"content":"五行各有正性，在人所禀有吉凶，發覺未萌，湏在期程之所極可定。賦云三冬暑少九陽多，亦以正氣為憑也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":40,"lineType":2,"content":"五行之運，隂陽相推，亦有不應和者，亦極相反。是謂死兮生之本，生兮死之源。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗隠其神，神成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"而嵗死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":42,"lineType":2,"content":"嵗，木也。神，火也。火盛則木死，勢不兩立，因恩而生害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"智從義出，智盛則義","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"蔵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":44,"lineType":2,"content":"智，水也。義，金也。金生水，水盛金蔵，未嘗不失於義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"信從四事，物物皆歸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":44,"lineType":2,"content":"鍾於土是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":46,"lineType":2,"content":"也。辰為木之土，戌為金之土，未為火之土，丑為水之土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼財相㑹，則凶中得吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":46,"lineType":2,"content":"如庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":48,"lineType":2,"content":"申得癸卯，是庚中月，乙卯有合會徳之財，癸卯為木之鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"觀刑逢妻，生旺不取。生月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"為父，胎月為母。身尅為妻，妻生為子。時生是妻子之數，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"成敗自然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":52,"lineType":2,"content":"以火尅金為父，則以生月定之。然後看日時承受胎月，有無刑害。身尅為妻，以日論之。妻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892072120363"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":56,"lineType":2,"content":"生為子，以時推之。乃看生旺刑制，五行之定數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"胎氣同往，當有異母。月干相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"逢，湏依二父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":58,"lineType":2,"content":"受胎正在受氣之地，而與日時支干同者，當食二母之乳。月干與年干相連，而同在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":60,"lineType":2,"content":"父母生地，當相交，或立身於二事而成也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"子息則先明生氣，或用尅以推之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":62,"lineType":2,"content":"如丁巳土以木為子孫，建至亥上得辛。若四柱見丁在無氣，更有刑害者，必少子孫也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"自生自旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"更看運元胎月。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":64,"lineType":2,"content":"如生納音在月旺處，更不論刑害子孫之地。如胎月在有氣處，於生時之上，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":66,"lineType":2,"content":"不絶子也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"祿馬不閒，子孫未必絶滅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":66,"lineType":2,"content":"若人生時見祿馬往來朝命，不犯孤寡，亦有子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":68,"lineType":2,"content":"孫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽和㑹，交友結心，同氣連枝，同名定數。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":68,"lineType":2,"content":"五行湏和順者，四海","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":70,"lineType":2,"content":"之人亦心於交友相結，况同胞兄弟，豈不得力？但五行中以此為兄弟，而無灾位也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"或有偶然同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892072136747"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"産一母以生，湏分深淺之時，復看五音向背。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":74,"lineType":2,"content":"凡一時有八刻二十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":76,"lineType":2,"content":"分，故有淺深前后，吉凶不同。其有以生湏分深淺，異姓則論五音向背。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"本音生旺，須至福" "0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":148,"lineType":1,"content":"胎本立於嵗前，因嵗得之胎月，故立胎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":150,"lineType":1,"content":"在嵗後月前。空刑敗害，日時倒亂，却得順奇，不為倒也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":152,"lineType":2,"content":"三刑、八敗、六害、空亡、相生、相絶、倒亂者，却得三奇順在本方，亦主富貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"日時無方，東里多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":154,"lineType":1,"content":"迍，根鮮枝榮，西門寡祿，根固時雄，花實無忒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":154,"lineType":2,"content":"日時之力，不輔三元，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":156,"lineType":2,"content":"或耗或尅，主災多。行年根苗花實，乃胎月日時相順為貴。若五行更到旺方，即為長逺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"應得位者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"支干谷有所刑，官或無氣也。上下湏依乎父母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":158,"lineType":2,"content":"入前格而貴者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":160,"lineType":2,"content":"支干中湏有衝刑之官，如無官，湏以徳運為清也。當死絶處，湏要逢父母，故子晉云：賴五行之救助。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":160,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892072218667"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":164,"lineType":1,"content":"主本，祿馬往來，湏分建破。天乙扶持，將徳侍衞。更辨尊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"𤰞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":166,"lineType":2,"content":"謂當用處有建不可破，已破却不可建。吉神在四柱中，各在四時，用干為貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"真合為𦂳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":166,"lineType":2,"content":"子巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":168,"lineType":2,"content":"卯巾之合為真。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"徳合不清，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":168,"lineType":2,"content":"甲子已丑、丙戌辛卯連順而貴尚不如壬子癸丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"連珠未顯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":170,"lineType":2,"content":"連珠，支干前後顛倒，皆不為顯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"空合何榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":170,"lineType":2,"content":"四柱相合，不扶六馬，本命即為不貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"支連干㑹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"連珠。真同鳳凰藪。刑全貴全，天赦祿食麒麟窟，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":172,"lineType":2,"content":"甲子乙丑、丙寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":174,"lineType":2,"content":"連順而貴尚不如壬子癸丑、甲寅乙卯為鳳凰藪，其貴清異。人生二刑，更晝夜貴神全，皆主文章清秀之貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"卯酉自分承不承，魁罡言之㑹不㑹，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":176,"lineType":2,"content":"乙酉得辛卯，辛酉得癸卯。而有辰戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":178,"lineType":2,"content":"言支干相承，用魁罡辰戌也。辰戌相衝，湏有寅亥申支，乃為相㑹，不相㑹為凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"罡中旺乙，魁裏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892072235051"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"伏辛。貴神得癸，小吉隠丁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":182,"lineType":2,"content":"辰中是乙，戌中是辛，乙丑為貴神，丑中有癸，未中是丁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":184,"lineType":1,"content":"有隂而無陽，乃四方之貢土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":184,"lineType":2,"content":"言癸、乙丁辛，皆隂干四位中貢成其物之土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":184,"lineType":1,"content":"陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"守正於魁罡，隂有用於丑未。金在火鄉，貴而遷逐，財則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":188,"lineType":1,"content":"孤勞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":188,"lineType":2,"content":"戊同辰戌，已同丑未。金命在火鄉，貴人多黜貴財，人則孤勞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":188,"lineType":1,"content":"體重為從革日新，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":190,"lineType":1,"content":"本輕則災殃短折。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":190,"lineType":2,"content":"金以火為官，若體重者，為火位中生，亦可成器。若金本輕而生於火鄉，更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":192,"lineType":2,"content":"遇之多，必短夭刑折。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"湏詳生尅之愛憎，舉一隅而辨衆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":192,"lineType":2,"content":"如金在火鄉，各以其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":194,"lineType":2,"content":"義辨生尅愛憎，而言吉凶。如水木火土，各以金之義而推之，故一隅足以辨衆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":194,"lineType":1,"content":"支干論配合之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"情，力氣取四時之義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":196,"lineType":2,"content":"五行生在三合中，各以生尅物化人倫之義，以辨吉凶。更看四時中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892072251435"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":200,"lineType":2,"content":"所得力氣，及支干配合真假，以定吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"仍分尊𤰞上下，筋脈交連，神煞吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"凶，以分髙下。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":202,"lineType":2,"content":"此重言者，欲人不忽於消息。言更看上下、先後、尊𤰞，見不見、抽不抽之筋脈情理，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":204,"lineType":2,"content":"神煞吉凶，而定榮謝也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":204,"lineType":1,"content":"至若貴神當位，諸煞伏蔵，三元旺相，豈専","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"神煞？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":206,"lineType":2,"content":"言天乙貴人論于干，看五行四時之氣，及晝夜之干而定。若有氣天乙當位，則煞自蔵矣。五行三元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":208,"lineType":2,"content":"為本，若在旺相之地，不背尅生氣，不論神煞也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":208,"lineType":1,"content":"或遇七元刑刼敗害，元亡衝破，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"在上無可救者，為頭目之疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":210,"lineType":2,"content":"七元干鬼者，對命是也。三刑刼煞，八敗六害，元亡衝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":212,"lineType":2,"content":"破者，犯真祿之位，見干鬼及三兩位，并犯胎命之建，更地位無救，主頭目疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"在下無可救者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"為手足之厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":214,"lineType":2,"content":"只犯納音支者，乃手足股肱之病，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"父母子孫奚能免害？生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892072267819"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":218,"lineType":1,"content":"時既用，行運亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":218,"lineType":2,"content":"如此之人，亦湏妨害六親，以三元尊𤰞而言也。又言已土七煞之凶，不惟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":220,"lineType":2,"content":"生時用於上下之灾，行運太嵗亦當與日時通論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":220,"lineType":1,"content":"木火則奔速，土金水乃容之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":222,"lineType":2,"content":"所遇上件破害，當向坐時運中更分五行遲速之性，火木漸上主速，土金水沉下主遲緩也。噫！造化寥廓，禍福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":224,"lineType":2,"content":"杳微，或積善而有灾殃，或積惡而多喜慶。盖禍福定於生時，善惡由人。然而天道福善禍淫，故君子修身以俟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":226,"lineType":2,"content":"命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"244","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"三元九限，　三元者，大小氣運也。九限者，三運之榮謝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"也。自生得節，日為初。陽男隂女順而理，隂男陽女逆而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"推。向者，數之未來，背者，用之已往。十干分之為月，三日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892072284203"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"成之一年。向背之數，湏得其實。未來無日，謂當日得節","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"也。當虚作嵗，背之同推。　行遊四柱，吉凶自然。小運同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"途，盛衰理異。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":240,"lineType":2,"content":"運至四柱中，伏反生尅，吉凶自然同年小運四柱所生有别也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"伏反之狀，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"災福仍分。本主之基，以辨吉凶之變。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":242,"lineType":2,"content":"伏，守也，逢合則動。反，動也，逢合則靜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":244,"lineType":2,"content":"先分君子小人之主本，次看運中吉凶變通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"小運天左地右，陽備於寅，隂備","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"於申，故男一嵗起於寅，女一嵗起於申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":246,"lineType":2,"content":"寅為三陽化主，申為三隂肅煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":248,"lineType":2,"content":"故男小運起於寅，女小運起於申。假如甲子年，男起丙寅，女起壬申之類是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"以建元而論勝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"負，助嵗運而依吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":250,"lineType":2,"content":"小運各以年遁月建五行而分生尅勝負。小運助大運，太嵗相依輔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892072300587"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":254,"lineType":2,"content":"而為吉凶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"反破刑孤，凶中有吉。寅申二命，小運不専。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":254,"lineType":2,"content":"返吟、衝伏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":256,"lineType":2,"content":"吟、害及孤病之類，雖是凶運，其中亦有吉者。二運生而小運伏吟、反吟，故不以小運専仕太嵗之上也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":258,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗一移，周而復始。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":258,"lineType":2,"content":"若一年各有一建而循𤨔也。不可以氣運取，男三十而女二十。陽自戊子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":260,"lineType":2,"content":"隂自庚子。男得丁巳，女得卒已。男順十月至丙寅，女逆十月至壬寅也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"氣者，時也。未有時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"而氣未定，既有時而氣以完。用之納音者，緣有身而得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":264,"lineType":2,"content":"言氣運，取生時五行納音之休旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"身者，三元之本也。氣者，身之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"本也。運既順而氣逆，運若逆而氣順。自生時為始，轉行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"不巳，推遷逐嵗一宫，以大小運分吉凶休祥，非命之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892072316971"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":272,"lineType":2,"content":"甲已土運，乙庚金運，乃天道起魁罡之運，主國家運祚之休祥，非云命之氣運也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"氣運併絶則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"厄。太嵗為君王，大運為元帥，氣運如曹使，小運若使臣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"帥，凶則曹使不能吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":276,"lineType":2,"content":"氣運二真運祿馬之氣併絶則死。太嵗為百神之主，大運氣運欲轉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":278,"lineType":2,"content":"輪不絶，則主本優游。大運主生煞之柄，故曹使不能違理，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹吉㑹凶，作用定矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":278,"lineType":2,"content":"在三元生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":280,"lineType":2,"content":"旺庫及祿馬旺處為㑹吉，居三元沐浴衰病死絶處逢禄馬為鬼，無和順者為會凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"其象大者至","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"於死絶，小者期於災撓。身湏逐運，運湏逐身，柱助運而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"凶反吉，柱敗運而吉復凶。時運逢馬吉凶馬上，一吉呼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"而百吉㑹，一凶馳而衆凶符。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":286,"lineType":2,"content":"太嵗起大運及主本尊者，則大危或死亡矣。小者有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892072333355"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":290,"lineType":2,"content":"用，雖自有福，若傷慢處亦主災撓。身運二者湏左右有符合資助為吉。柱為主，運為客，客為主害，無不凶也。二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":292,"lineType":2,"content":"運到馬上，即看馬上之吉凶，馬主動，必湏細取三元四柱而論，不可以馬吉而不言馬上有凶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"吉若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"勝凶，凶蔵吉內。凶若勝吉，吉隠凶中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":294,"lineType":2,"content":"其言吉凶有相反，如季主云使盡吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":296,"lineType":2,"content":"合則殃也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"運限之道，有天官限者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":296,"lineType":2,"content":"三元到中庸之地，見貴逢合，或只有貴却無合，或有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":298,"lineType":2,"content":"合而無貴。四柱相生，運嵗相輔，凡得此限，君子將榮，庶人獲安，事事皆吉。　有得勢限。三元俱到旺相地，四柱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":300,"lineType":2,"content":"相資承。　有龜蔵限。如祿金入土干下者是也。命金入土支下，身金入土納音下者，則暮春之優㳺，不利君子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":302,"lineType":2,"content":"利乎小人，盖子弱母勝也。　有波浪限。金人運到亥子嵗，乃小運上是也。木人大危，餘人意思不調，飄泛如舟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":304,"lineType":2,"content":"也。　有風雨限。運到三元衰絶處，氣運小運又為祿鬼，如此則吉凶相繼，來去迅速，勢若風雨暴遇而無所繫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892072349739"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":308,"lineType":2,"content":"也。　有布素限。行運到身旺相攴干死絶是也。若太嵗小運扶助本命，雖入災運，於十載之間亦有五年之吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":310,"lineType":2,"content":"不至於凶甚。以此消息，故名布素限。分前後，五年不吉，後運則助。五年無凶，後運若凶則凶咎。　有失所限。三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":312,"lineType":2,"content":"元俱值鬼，二運見三刑併衝柱，主本與行年不相承，作黄泉失所之命也。　有破碎限。此非死限，只是金破碎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":314,"lineType":2,"content":"去如流水而不返，諸運氣沐浴，更逢真鬼，謂甲衰而有庚之類。　有災位限。運至伏吟，上逢䘮弔，見白衣、飛廉、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":316,"lineType":2,"content":"孤寡、嵗刑尅身者，是主災位之事。凡得此限，則親戚不利，主有䘮服。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"夫三元九限者，乃人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"之利也。四柱三才者，乃人之本也。本輕則大者小，利小","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":320,"lineType":1,"content":"則主本貧，而更無運路，亦惶惶無所依矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":320,"lineType":2,"content":"本大者得之小，猶勝小者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":322,"lineType":2,"content":"得之大。本小者得之大，未及大者得之小。本重則利重，本輕則利輕。本重得小者遐邇無凶，得大者官清祿崇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638803892072366123"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":326,"lineType":2,"content":"本輕則小者，且福且利，得大者，吉極防凶。有小者，如物待時，得時則萬物滋長；本無者，如折木懸空，氣過則花","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":328,"lineType":2,"content":"實併敗。是故木生於震，臨離兑以多殃；火産東南，赴天門而寡祿；金降自乾東而震北，遇坤鄉而敗祿衰官；水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":330,"lineType":2,"content":"長逢火木崇方，復乾宫而潛身退跡。五土忌於真敗，隨氣運以詳之。又土無正位，隨真運而敗。甲已土敗在酉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":332,"lineType":2,"content":"乙庚金敗在午，丙辛水敗在酉，丁壬木敗在子，戊癸火敗在卯。各以十干所配消息而取用也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
