:"465","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"夫寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"午戌之𩔖，乃五行體合，三生之㑹也。子丑之類，地支嵗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"合也。甲巳之類，真氣徳合也。寅丑未之類，天地真刑㑹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":410,"lineType":1,"content":"也。甲得丑未，無合有合也。丁見亥之𩔖，祿氣通合也。申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"見乙，支合干也。甲見亥，干合支也。各看失位之輕重，得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805117285728310"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"地之清濁，上下配偶，親踈之𦂳慢也。其神頭祿者，乃隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"陽専位，天地神㑹也。列八卦之真源，演五行之成敗，剛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"柔相推，有無合化也。故壬子之水，應北方之坎；丙午之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":422,"lineType":1,"content":"火，實南宫之離。所以丙午得壬子不為破，丁巳得癸亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":424,"lineType":1,"content":"不為衝。是水火相濟之源，有夫婦配合之理。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":424,"lineType":2,"content":"坎離為男女精神之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":426,"lineType":2,"content":"中者也。壬子見丙午，癸丑見丁已，則先水後火，有未濟之象。又不如丁已見壬子，丙午得癸亥也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":426,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉之金，應西方之兑。甲寅、乙卯之木，象東方之震。凡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":430,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅得庚申不為刑，乙卯得辛酉不為鬼。是木女金夫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805117285744694"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":434,"lineType":1,"content":"之正體，明左右之神化也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":434,"lineType":2,"content":"木主魂，金主魄，二者左右相間不合。若能全合，則神之化","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":436,"lineType":2,"content":"生以間也。若庚申見乙卯，辛酉得甲寅，不為變識之用也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰、戊戌之土為魁罡相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":438,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹，乾坤厚徳，覆載含生，不得以為反吟也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":438,"lineType":2,"content":"戊辰、戊戌不為衝破，是土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":440,"lineType":2,"content":"得正位於守元㑹也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":440,"lineType":1,"content":"已丑、巳未是貴神，形體具備，守位忠貞，動靜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"不常。此四維真土，有萬物終始之道，非才能明於日月，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"器度廣於山川，大人君子孰能備徳？况神頭祿各有神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":446,"lineType":1,"content":"以主之，應日臨神或左右運動於六合之中，盈縮於吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"凶之變也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":448,"lineType":2,"content":"巳丑土為天乙貴人，乙未土為太常福神，觧百煞之凶，配一人之徳。吉以吉應，逐凶釋凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805117285761078"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":452,"lineType":2,"content":"若得之當用，則為橫財之善。若戊辰為勾陳，戊戌為天空亡之神，多遷改君師外藩，出鎮邊防，有所不常矣。丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":454,"lineType":2,"content":"巳為螣蛇之神，凶以凶用，吉以吉承，多熒惑之憂，有滑稽之性。丙午為朱雀之神，應陽明之體，文辭藻麗。甲寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":456,"lineType":2,"content":"為青龍之神，博施濟衆，得四方之利。乙卯為六合之神，主發生榮華，和弱順儻。壬子為天后之神，主隂隲天徳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":458,"lineType":2,"content":"容美多權。癸亥為𤣥武之神，乃隂陽極終，有潛伏之氣，從下如流，雖名大智，非軒昂超達之士，不可姑息，順則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":460,"lineType":2,"content":"安平，逆則奸危。庚申為白虎之神，利於武而不利於文，有抱道旅羈之性，善中嚴内，色厲内荏，有仁義，好幽僻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":462,"lineType":2,"content":"辛酉為太隂之神，懐肅殺之氣者，有清白之風，為文章和易不世之才，然後各以親踈休旺定之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"水土名用　土本無一方之氣，從水妻之義也。隂陽各","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"逐四時成就。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":466,"lineType":2,"content":"辰中有乙，則木土成之，故在寅夘。辰中之土，隨木之生旺也。魁裏蔵辛，則金土成之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805117285777462"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":470,"lineType":2,"content":"故在申酉，戌之土隨金之生旺也。貴神得癸，則水土成之，故在亥子，丑之土隨水之生旺也。未隱丁火，則火土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":472,"lineType":2,"content":"成之，故在已午。未之土隨火之生旺也。大體如此，則其土之用，皆喜於辰戌丑未也。戊氣從戌從巳，戌火鍾而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":474,"lineType":2,"content":"上育，已火極而土成；巳氣從亥從午，亥火之絶也，土生，午火之旺也，土音。盖已午為火極，戌亥為火熄，父母極","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":476,"lineType":2,"content":"熄而子孫成之，與水之異也，二氣俱逆，戊得丑而為，巳得未，已自亥逆至未旺，戌自已逆至丑旺，天地之中庫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":478,"lineType":2,"content":"於辰，金土之會成於戌。然則水土當育於寅，隂陽之中，卯酉為無止之地，子午為夫旺婦極之所，丑乃木立形","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":480,"lineType":2,"content":"而上蔵，甲為金成而土衰，戌作魁而利，乃土發之獨用不從四時之義也。其立用之方，盖土無定形，雖載其文","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":482,"lineType":2,"content":"而未可究其指，故存之以待來者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
